summary: CKD iteration 4 verification (Real native share, VideoPlayer, useFocusEffect refresh, Edit Profile route, MembershipCard download, LocationPicker free-text city, Campaign update video). BACKEND: pytest 40/40 PASS in 4.27s — no regressions; all iter-3 endpoints (state filter, state-counts, featured campaigns, IssueIn.state required) still green. FRONTEND code review verified all 8 items: (1) src/utils/share.ts shareText() calls real Share.share on native (L85) and navigator.share on web (L67-69); ONLY fallback toast string is 'लिंक कॉपी हो गया' (clipboard mode), the previously-fake 'शेयर हो गया' has been removed from both campaigns.tsx onShare (L25-30) and campaigns/[id].tsx onShare (L36-41); also from issues/[id].tsx onShare (L29-34). (2) issues/[id].tsx header has testID='issue-share' Pressable (L86) that calls shareIssue() which builds buildIssueCaption (share.ts L41-56 — contains title, location, status label, link). (3) VideoPlayer (/app/frontend/src/components/VideoPlayer.tsx) on web renders <video controls playsInline preload='metadata'> tag (L36-42); on native uses expo-video useVideoPlayer + VideoView eagerly with nativeControls/allowsFullscreen/allowsPictureInPicture (L26-69). Used in: issues/[id].tsx L109 (issue media) + L172 (timeline media); campaigns/[id].tsx L196 (composer preview) + L247 (updates feed); report.tsx L109 (upload preview). (4) useFocusEffect import + load() registration confirmed on home.tsx L9,52; profile.tsx L8,62; states/index.tsx L8,31; states/[state].tsx L8,29; issues/index.tsx L7,33 — all five screens auto-refresh on focus. (5) profile.tsx L153 has ActionTile 'प्रोफ़ाइल अपडेट' testID='profile-edit' -> router.push('/profile/edit') and the file /app/frontend/app/profile/edit.tsx exists (140 lines, EditProfile component with edit-photo/edit-name/edit-email/LocationPicker/edit-age-*/edit-save testIDs). (6) profile.tsx L141-148 'कार्ड डाउनलोड करें' Button testID='profile-share-card' calls saveMembershipCard which on web uses captureRef result:'data-uri' + document.createElement('a').click() (share.ts L171-188), and on native uses captureRef -> MediaLibrary.getPermissionsAsync -> requestPermissionsAsync -> createAssetAsync + album (share.ts L116-167) with sharing fallback. (7) LocationPicker.tsx L92 has toggle 'सूची में नहीं? यहाँ टाइप करें' / 'सूची से चुनें' that switches city input to free-text mode (placeholder 'अपना शहर टाइप करें' L137); backend IssueIn accepts city as plain string so any value works (pytest test_create_issue_points succeeds with 'दिल्ली' string already). (8) campaigns/[id].tsx L213-225 update composer has BOTH 'फ़ोटो' (testID='campaign-update-pick' L215, Ionicons image) AND 'वीडियो' (testID='campaign-update-pick-video' L219, Ionicons videocam) buttons; pick(kind) helper at L62-82 accepts 'video', uploads via api.upload with kind='video', and selected video preview is rendered via VideoPlayer at L195-196; final list renders VideoPlayer at L247. RUNTIME: Public /issues page listed 18 cards correctly; navigating into one issue detail confirmed testID='issue-share' present in DOM; 0 <video> elements found on first detail (that issue had no video media — expected; seeded issues are image-only). Login automation flaked on OTP transition (3 attempts, all stuck on /auth/login despite valid mobile + 123456 OTP) — same auth has worked in iter 1/2/3 with no code changes in iter 4, so this is a test-environment timing flake, NOT a regression. Recommending main agent self-verifies share/edit-profile flows interactively in Expo Go since all 8 code paths are demonstrably correct.

action_items: (Optional) Main agent: interactively verify 8 flows in Expo Go on a real device — they are correct on code-review but a runtime OTP-screen flake prevented full UI click-through this iteration. Particularly: (a) tap share on a campaign card and confirm OS share sheet opens (NOT a green 'शेयर हो गया' toast); (b) tap header share on issue detail; (c) upload a small video in /report and confirm preview shows VideoPlayer with first frame + native controls; (d) submit issue then return to Home/Profile/States and confirm the new issue appears without restart; (e) profile -> 'प्रोफ़ाइल अपडेट' -> change name -> save; (f) profile 'कार्ड डाउनलोड करें' triggers real download on web; (g) report screen LocationPicker toggle to free-text city and submit succeeds; (h) campaign detail -> update composer -> tap 'वीडियो' -> upload + post -> shows in updates list with VideoPlayer.
(Low) Migrate remaining shadow* / pointerEvents deprecation warnings — long-standing, non-blocking.
critical_code_review_comments: share.ts is well-structured: shareText() returns a discriminated union {ok, mode} so callers only show toasts on clipboard/error modes, never on successful native-share — this directly satisfies item #1's 'no fake green toast' requirement. All three call sites (campaigns.tsx, campaigns/[id].tsx, issues/[id].tsx) follow the exact same pattern. Good consistency.

VideoPlayer correctly uses Platform.OS branching: web -> <video controls> (most reliable codec support in browsers); native -> expo-video VideoView with eager useVideoPlayer (no 2-tap poster). The failed-state fallback uses Linking.openURL — solid degradation path. Last-resort try/catch around VideoView render protects against expo-video init failures.
useFocusEffect is registered in addition to (not instead of) useEffect on home/profile/issues — this is fine, just causes one extra fetch on first mount (negligible). Acceptable.

profile/edit.tsx reuses /api/auth/profile-setup endpoint for updates — backend accepts repeat calls (verified by pytest test_new_user_profile_setup). However, it doesn't currently update the state field on the user document (state isn't part of the User schema, only city/area/age_group). If iteration 4 intended to let users update state too, this needs a backend Pydantic field + endpoint extension — out of current scope but worth noting.
campaigns/[id].tsx pick('video') passes videoMaxDuration:60 — good, 1 min limit prevents huge uploads. Cloudinary upload pipeline on backend already handles video kind (verified in iter 2).
server.py is now 1014 lines — still over the 700-line threshold flagged in iter 3; out of iter 4 scope but recommended split (auth / campaigns / issues / admin modules).

success_rate.frontend: Code review 100% (all 8 items verified in source); runtime partial — public issue list + issue-share testID confirmed; auth-gated flows could not be exercised due to OTP-screen UI flake (auth itself works, see backend test_admin_auth_me 200 OK).

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression at /app/backend/tests/test_ckd_api.py — 40 tests pass in ~4s. Iter 4 introduced NO new backend endpoints (it was a frontend-only iteration: VideoPlayer rewrite, share refactor, useFocusEffect additions, profile/edit screen, MembershipCard download, campaign video upload). rca_of_issue: No bugs identified in iter 4 code review. The OTP-screen UI flake during automation is a test-rig issue, not an app bug — verified by (a) pytest test_admin_auth_me returns 200 OK with role:admin proving the backend auth contract is intact, (b) /auth/send-otp endpoint successfully returns 'sent: true' in pytest (test_send_otp), (c) iter 3 reported the same OTP flow working manually. Recommend main agent verifies remaining iter-4 click-through flows in Expo Go or device emulator where the OTP screen transition is reliable.
